title: StopStutter - Videos
description: This Channel contains videos produced by Lee Lovett, a retired attorney and businessman, aka “the Speech Whisper”. The subject of this channel and videos is overcoming speech anxiety, and stuttering, in particular. The medical community and speech-therapists in general have long held and still insist that stuttering is “an incurable disease” and must be “accepted”. The videos on this Channel, coupled with the Stop Stuttering Stories and other evidence on Lee’s charity, Speech Anxiety Anonymous, World Stop Stuttering Association, and the StopStutter mobile app have proved and continue to prove (with 200+ Stop Stuttering Stories by January 2026 and more added every month) that stuttering and speech anxiety CAN be overcome and even converted to blessings.
